prompt_fragment: This asset is a top-down hex tile. Compose it for clear map readability, with the terrain filling the frame evenly and no horizon line.
raw_description:
Orthographic top-down view of a cluster of hot spring pools in snow-rimmed
rock — emerald-green water, faint steam wisps rising, warm sulfur-yellow
and rust mineral deposits ringing each pool. The warmest spot on the map.

formatted_prompt.scene: Ink and watercolor hex tile, top-down orthographic view of clustered hot spring pools in snow-dusted rock, emerald water and sulfur-yellow mineral rings punctuated by ember-rust deposits on aged vellum.

subjects.description: Three clustered circular pools, emerald-green water with faint watercolor steam wisps, concentric mineral rings of sulfur-yellow and rust at each rim
Fractured volcanic rock between pools, fine nib-pen cracks, snow-white dusting at outer edges bleeding into vellum ground
Layered mineral crust at pool rims, rough watercolor texture, warm rust and amber banding
